                    by: f.slot, sid: sid, x: x, y: y, dmg: f.dmg,
                    fx: f.pos.x, fy: f.pos.y, fAng: f.wAngle,      // firing pose — the audit recomputes the mid-spine birth from exactly these
                  });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function killShot(G, st, reason, foe, gap) {
    if (st.returns && G.fighters[st.o]) {
      const ow = G.fighters[st.o];
      ow.catchWait = RETHROW_WAIT;   // instantthrow-r59: RETHROW_WAIT is 0 — the gate never holds, the rethrow leaves on the next substep. The line stays (dormant machinery, cheap revert): at r54 this was the hand-rest beat (owner's eye then: "it looks bad when its instant throwing after catch"; reversed at r59: "just instantly throw it")
      const Wr = WEAPONS[ow.weapon];
      const sm = 1 + (Wr.shot.mult || 0) + ((FIGHTERS[ow.idx].skill && FIGHTERS[ow.idx].skill.shotMult) || 0) + ((Wr.trait && Wr.trait.mult) || 0) * Math.min(ow.shotStep, MULT_STEPS);   // the fireShots cadence seam, mirrored: the top-up is exactly one volley's `need`
      ow.fireAcc = Math.max(ow.fireAcc, TAU * (Wr.shot.revs || 1) / (sm > 0 ? sm : 1));   // the rethrow revolution is BANKED AT THE END of the flight — instantthrow-r59: with RETHROW_WAIT 0 that makes the hurl INSTANT (the owner's word), no cadence wait; under the r54 beat it made the throw leave exactly when the hand-rest expired
    }
    if (st.skewVictim) releaseSkew(G, st.skewVictim, reason === 'swat' ? 'cut' : reason, st.sid);   // skewer-r46: destroying the anchored spear frees the impaled foe — the CUT (their own blade), a cross (any enemy shot — the victim's own shot shooting it out is an emergent escape), any destruction at all
    if (reason === 'swat') {
      G.stats.swatted++;
      const sev = {
        by: foe.slot, sid: st.sid, x: st.x, y: st.y, sr: st.r, gap: gap,
        fFl: foe.fl.u.slice(),                                            // swatter chain pose (flail)
        fx: foe.pos.x, fy: foe.pos.y, fAng: foe.wAngle, fW: foe.weapon,   // swatter pose — the audit recomputes the touch from exactly these
      };
      if (WEAPONS[foe.weapon].lead || WEAPONS[foe.weapon].headLead) sev.fSp = foe.spin;                   // edge-leading: the swatter's signed spin at the touch (flagged weapons only)
      emit(G, 'swat', sev);
    } else if (reason === 'rim') {
      G.stats.rim++;
      emit(G, 'shotRim', { by: st.o, sid: st.sid, x: st.x, y: st.y, sr: st.r });
    } else if (reason === 'catch') {                     // touchorbit-r53 the PURE-TOUCH catch: the world orbit actually crossed the wielder's body — an event, not an invariant; catchonly-r56: the ONLY returns departure left (blades and projectiles are immune-passed), and the arc-aware arm guarantees it is a real intercept, never the departure tick
      emit(G, 'shotCatch', { by: st.o, sid: st.sid, x: st.x, y: st.y, sr: st.r });
    } else {                                             // 'cross' — shot-vs-shot cancel; snapfix-r57: loop vs projectile the cancel is ONE-SIDED — the projectile dies here alone, the loop flies on; catchghost-r58: a boomerang PAIR reaches the shared both-die path (killShot fires twice, one per arc)
      G.stats.crossed++;
      emit(G, 'shotCross', { sid: st.sid, x: st.x, y: st.y, sr: st.r });
    }
  }

  function shotHitBody(G, fs, st, foe, bd) {
    const owner = fs[st.o];
    const dealt = st.dmg;
    foe.hp = Math.max(0, foe.hp - dealt);
    const vd = Math.hypot(st.vx, st.vy) || 1;            // knock along the shot's flight line — except a NAIL's (pinfix-r45): its velocity is the frozen impact facing (art), so the knock reads the stored inward normal pnx/pny instead
    const kx = st.pinned ? st.pnx : st.vx / vd, ky = st.pinned ? st.pny : st.vy / vd;
    foe.vel.x += kx * CFG.hitKnock;
    foe.vel.y += ky * CFG.hitKnock;
    G.stats.landed++;
    if (!st.returns || HIT_GROW) grow(G, owner);
    /* affinity-r66 — THE TRIO'S VICTIM-SIDE PAYLOADS: the page's KIND carries its element (AFFINITY's
     * keys are tome-only art kinds), applied on the damaging hit — the ONE trigger. Fire needs no
     * status: its payload was the birth size (trioRadius). Kills apply too — the round ends anyway. */
    const afEl = AFFINITY[st.kind];
    if (afEl) {
      if (foe.dot) foe.dot.ttl = TRIO.poisonTtl;     // ANY page of the book SUSTAINS the curses (the first smoke caught the cycle self-diluting: every 3rd page + swats starved a per-element refresh — so the book's pressure keeps them alive…)
      if (foe.chill) foe.chill.ttl = TRIO.chillTtl;
      if (afEl === 'poison') applyPoison(G, foe);    // …and the element's OWN page DEEPENS its status (the fire payload rides the shared counter the same way: any hit grows the swell)
      else if (afEl === 'frost') applyChill(G, foe);
    }
    // bloom-r73 — TRANSFIGURATION: the comet's hit is the shot-side bloom trigger (the spine side lives in bladeVsBody)
    if (owner.weapon === 'wand' && WEAPONS.wand.trait.fig > 0) tryFig(G, WEAPONS.wand, owner, foe);
    // emberpool-r79 — THE BURNING POOL: every damaging scroll hit leaves fire where the victim stood
    if (owner.weapon === 'scroll') {
      G.pools.push({ x: foe.pos.x, y: foe.pos.y, r: POOL.r, t: POOL.life, acc: 0, in: false, o: owner.slot, dmg: Math.max(0.5, owner.dmg * POOL.rate), sid: st.sid });
      if (G.pools.length > POOL.cap) G.pools.shift();   // the lace guard: oldest fire dies young
      G.stats.pools++;
      emit(G, 'pool', { by: owner.slot, sid: st.sid, x: foe.pos.x, y: foe.pos.y });
    }
    // growth: exactly as blade hits — freeloop-r38: HIT_GROW is FALSE (owner ruling 2026-10-31, "each catch and throw makes it faster" — hits damage only), so a returning shot's pass-through hit never grows; the catch cycle is the trigger
    const kill = foe.hp <= 0;
    if (kill) { foe.alive = false; foe.deathSeq = ++G.deathSeq; }
    emit(G, 'hit', {
      by: owner.slot, to: foe.slot, dealt: dealt, kill: kill, shot: true, sid: st.sid,
      x: foe.pos.x, y: foe.pos.y,                        // victim at the contact instant
      sx: st.x, sy: st.y, sr: st.r, gap: bd - (CFG.bodyR + st.r),   // shot at its death instant — the audit recomputes the touch from these
      spin: Math.abs(owner.spin), dmg: owner.dmg,
    });
  }

  /* skewer-r46 — THE JAVELIN'S SKEWER. Victim state f.skew = { phase 'carry'|'pin', t, dur,
   * sx/sy (carry start), dx/dy (rim dest — along the FLIGHT LINE, javelincarry-r52), spinBase (the EXACT spin restore), bleedAcc, nx/ny
   * (inward normal), cutArm, anchor (the impaling shot ref) }; the shot carries st.skewVictim
   * (ref) + st.skewCarry (the swat-exempt grace flag). The pin reuses the NAIL machinery
   * (pinned, speed 0, pnx/pny, snapped just inside the rim — the budget reads speed, the art
   * reads the frozen flight line). Release: killShot's hook — ANY destruction of the anchor
   * frees (the victim's blade cut, an enemy cross, ...), and the roll resets f.skew wholesale
   * (the round-reset LAW). No pin clock: the crawl is the timer. */
  function startSkewer(G, st, foe) {
    const half = CFG.size / 2;
    const sp = Math.hypot(st.vx, st.vy) || 1;
    const ux = st.vx / sp, uy = st.vy / sp;                  // javelincarry-r52: the flight line IS the carry line again — AND the facing the spear keeps the whole way (owner: "the targets should get carried by the javelin in the javelins direction, but right now its the target which carries the javelin to the nearest rim in their direction"; the carrydir-r51 victim-heading drag is retired, and with it the r50/r51 facing turn — "instead of suddenly turning left or right to hit the rim")
    const px = foe.pos.x - half, py = foe.pos.y - half;
    const R = half - CFG.bodyR;                              // the boundary's own clamp radius — the dest is exactly where the wall would stop them
    const b = px * ux + py * uy;
    const t = -b + Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, b * b - (px * px + py * py) + R * R));   // the exit crossing guarantees û·r̂_dest > 0 — the forward ray from the centre along û always reaches the snap radius
    const o0x = st.x - foe.pos.x, o0y = st.y - foe.pos.y;    // the frozen impact offset — the sink's start (the point where it hit)
    foe.skew = {
      phase: 'carry', t: 0, dur: Math.max(0.1, t / SKEWER.carrySpeed),
      sx: foe.pos.x, sy: foe.pos.y, dx: foe.pos.x + ux * t, dy: foe.pos.y + uy * t,
      spinBase: foe.spin, bleedAcc: 0, nx: 0, ny: 0, cutArm: 0, anchor: st,
      ux: ux, uy: uy,                                        // the flight line — the carry line AND the nail drive's forward-only direction; the facing never leaves it (zero turn: the sinkalign rotation is retired at the owner's eye)
      ox0: o0x, oy0: o0y,                                    // sinkalign-r50: the impact offset, frozen — the sink interpolates DOWN from it to zero (the centre)
      driving: 0, driven: 0, sEnd: 0, dsx: 0, dsy: 0,        // the NAIL-DRIVE sub-phase fields (armed at rim arrival)
    };
    foe.spin = (foe.spin < 0 ? -1 : 1) * SKEWER.spin;        // the crawl starts AT THE HIT (owner: "once the spear carries the opponent… spin slower") — sign kept, leadFlip reads it
    foe.bladeStuck = false;                                  // the carry tears out of any latch — no deep-gate fight mid-drag
    st.skewVictim = foe; st.skewCarry = 1;
    st.skewOx = o0x; st.skewOy = o0y;   // skewfix-r47 + sinkalign-r50 (owner eye-ruling: "when a javelin hits an opponents, it instantly snaps to the centre, it looks bad… make its carry the opponent and also pin from the place where it initially hit"): the spear stays BURIED AT ITS IMPACT POINT — carried and pinned at this constant offset from the body, never snapped to the centre or to the rim
    emit(G, 'skewer', { by: st.o, to: foe.slot, sid: st.sid, x: foe.pos.x, y: foe.pos.y, dist: t });
  }

  function skewStep(G, f, sdt) {
    const s = f.skew;
    if (s.phase === 'carry') {
      s.t += sdt;
      const a = Math.min(1, s.t / s.dur);
      f.pos.x = s.sx + (s.dx - s.sx) * a; f.pos.y = s.sy + (s.dy - s.sy) * a;
      const cx = s.dx - s.sx, cy = s.dy - s.sy, cd = Math.hypot(cx, cy) || 1;
      f.vel.x = cx / cd * SKEWER.carrySpeed; f.vel.y = cy / cd * SKEWER.carrySpeed;   // budget honesty: every velocity reader (the substep budget, the chaos clamp) sees the drag
      if (a >= 1) {                                          // rim arrival → THE NAIL DRIVE (naildrive-r49, owner: "here i want the javelin to go through as the last nail… it moves into the rim as a nail and only forward from its position"): the victim locks at the rim; the spear — still buried at its impact point — advances FORWARD-ONLY along its own flight line into the wall
        s.phase = 'pin';
        const st = s.anchor, half = CFG.size / 2;
        const nx = f.pos.x - half, ny = f.pos.y - half, nd = Math.hypot(nx, ny) || 1;
        s.nx = -nx / nd; s.ny = -ny / nd;
        f.pos.x = s.dx; f.pos.y = s.dy;
        f.vel.x = 0; f.vel.y = 0;
        st.skewOx = 0; st.skewOy = 0; st.x = s.dx; st.y = s.dy;    // the ride AND the sink COMPLETE at the dest — same seam law as the r49/r50 ride-completion fixes (a transition landing mid-substep would otherwise strand the anchor a fraction short of the centre: the smoothstep already delivered it to within a subpixel, this settles it exactly)
        s.dsx = st.x; s.dsy = st.y;                          // javelincarry-r52: the drive starts at the body centre along the FLIGHT LINE (s.ux/uy untouched — the spear keeps going the way it was thrown; the r50 facing/line rewrite to the arrival radial is retired)
        const ppx = st.x - half, ppy = st.y - half;
        const Rs = half - st.r - 0.5;                        // the nail's snap radius: the head seats just inside the rim
        const bb = ppx * s.ux + ppy * s.uy;
        s.sEnd = Math.max(0, -bb + Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, bb * bb - (ppx * ppx + ppy * ppy) + Rs * Rs)));   // the forward ray always exits the snap circle (a stuck point already past it seats at once — sEnd 0)
        s.driving = 1; s.driven = 0;
      }
    } else {                                                 // 'pin': the victim is locked to the rim — the position law beats every force (gravity, knock and resolver pushes are all re-locked next substep)
      f.pos.x = s.dx; f.pos.y = s.dy;
      f.vel.x = 0; f.vel.y = 0;
      const st = s.anchor;
      if (s.driving) {                                       // THE NAIL DRIVE: forward-only along the flight line until the head seats just inside the rim — through the body, into the wall
        s.driven += SKEWER.driveSpeed * sdt;
        const k2 = Math.min(s.driven, s.sEnd);
        st.x = s.dsx + s.ux * k2; st.y = s.dsy + s.uy * k2;
        st.skewOx = st.x - f.pos.x; st.skewOy = st.y - f.pos.y;
        if (s.driven >= s.sEnd) {                            // SEATED: the nail's state — at rest, knock normal stored, the cut-free window opens
          s.driving = 0;
          st.pinned = true; st.speed = 0;
          const h2 = CFG.size / 2, rx = st.x - h2, ry = st.y - h2, rd = Math.hypot(rx, ry) || 1;
          st.pnx = -rx / rd; st.pny = -ry / rd;
          st.skewCarry = 0;
          emit(G, 'skewerPin', { to: f.slot, sid: st.sid, x: st.x, y: st.y });
        }
      }
      if (st.skewCarry || st.pinned) {                       // naildrive-r49: the cut window aims at the spear's ACTUAL position from the victim — right for the head-on pin AND the grazing carry where the nail seats downrange along the wall
        const ax = st.x - f.pos.x, ay = st.y - f.pos.y, ad = Math.hypot(ax, ay) || 1;
        if (!s.cutArm && (Math.cos(f.wAngle) * ax + Math.sin(f.wAngle) * ay) / ad <= SKEWER.cutCos) s.cutArm = 1;   // the blade must leave the window once before it can cut — no instant escapes
      }
    }
  }

  function skewBleed(G, f) {
    const s = f.skew;
    if (s.phase === 'carry' && !SKEWER.carryBleed) return;   // the owner's eye-judgment toggle — carry bleed may die alone; PIN bleed is unconditional (the owner's 100%)
    if (++s.bleedAcc < SKEWER.bleedEvery) return;
    s.bleedAcc = 0;
    f.hp = Math.max(0, f.hp - SKEWER.bleedDmg);
    const kill = f.hp <= 0;
    if (kill) { f.alive = false; f.deathSeq = ++G.deathSeq; }
    emit(G, 'bleedTick', { to: f.slot, dealt: SKEWER.bleedDmg, hp: f.hp, kill: kill, x: f.pos.x, y: f.pos.y });
  }

  /* affinity-r66 — THE TRIO STATUSES: two shallow victim fields (f.dot, f.chill), the SLOT LAW in
   * applyPoison/applyChill, and dotStep mirroring skewBleed exactly (per-TICK rhythm, hp clamp,
   * death + deathSeq, honest events — the proven DoT path). chillMul is the tempo multiplier the
   * weapon-swing site reads (chillfix-r71, owner ruling: the slow never touches the body — the bot
   * never drags or falls; the cadence follows the swing because casting is per-rev); it returns
   * EXACTLY 1 with no chill, so every non-tome match stays bit-identical (x * 1 === x). */
  function applyPoison(G, f) {
    const d = f.dot;
    if (d && d.k === 'poison') { d.n = Math.min(d.n + 1, TRIO.steps); d.ttl = TRIO.poisonTtl; }   // same status: DEEPEN + refresh
    else f.dot = { k: 'poison', n: 1, acc: 0, ttl: TRIO.poisonTtl };                             // a different DoT would REPLACE at 1 stack (the slot law) — poison is the only DoT today
    emit(G, 'poison', { to: f.slot, n: f.dot.n });
  }
  function applyChill(G, f) {
    const c = f.chill;
    if (c) { c.n = Math.min(c.n + 1, TRIO.steps); c.ttl = TRIO.chillTtl; }
    else f.chill = { n: 1, ttl: TRIO.chillTtl };
    emit(G, 'chill', { to: f.slot, n: f.chill.n });
  }
  function chillMul(f) {
    const c = f.chill;
    if (!c || !(c.n > 0)) return 1;
    return Math.max(TRIO.chillFloor, 1 - TRIO.chillPer * Math.min(c.n, TRIO.steps));
  }
  // bloomfix-r77 — THE LAZY SWEEP: a bloomed weapon still sweeps (it IS a weapon, held and swung) but at
  // FIG.slow of its tempo, so the viewer has time to read the burger. Weapon-only, exactly the chill
  // doctrine (chillfix-r71): the sweep sags, the BODY never does — movement, jumps, cadence-of-body untouched.
  function bloomMul(f) {
    return f.figT > 0 ? FIG.slow : 1;
  }
  function dotStep(G, f) {
    const d = f.dot;
    if (d) {
      if (--d.ttl <= 0) { f.dot = null; emit(G, 'dotEnd', { to: f.slot, k: d.k }); }
      else if (++d.acc >= TRIO.poisonEvery) {
        d.acc = 0;
        const dmg = TRIO.poisonDmg * d.n;
        f.hp = Math.max(0, f.hp - dmg);
        const kill = f.hp <= 0;
        if (kill) { f.alive = false; f.deathSeq = ++G.deathSeq; }
        emit(G, 'poisonTick', { to: f.slot, dealt: dmg, hp: f.hp, kill: kill, x: f.pos.x, y: f.pos.y });
      }
    }
    const c = f.chill;
    if (c && --c.ttl <= 0) { f.chill = null; emit(G, 'chillEnd', { to: f.slot }); }
  }
  function releaseSkew(G, v, how, sid) {
    const s = v.skew;
    if (!s) return;
    v.skew = null;
    v.spin = s.spinBase;                                     // EXACT restore — grow() mirrored every impaled landing onto spinBase, so growth during the pin survives
    if (s.phase === 'pin' && v.alive) { v.vel.x += s.nx * SKEWER.releaseKnock; v.vel.y += s.ny * SKEWER.releaseKnock; }   // the pop off the wall
    emit(G, 'skewerFree', { to: v.slot, how: how, phase: s.phase, sid: sid !== undefined ? sid : s.anchor.sid });
  }

  function shotStep(G, fs, sdt) {
    // survivors compact in place (order preserved, no per-substep arrays);
    // cross casualties drop in the second compaction
    const shots = G.shots;
    if (!shots.length) return;
    const half = CFG.size / 2;
    let w = 0;                                           // write index: survivors so far
    for (let i = 0; i < shots.length; i++) {
      const st = shots[i];
      if (st.eiv) { st.emb += sdt; const iv = st.eiv / CFG.tickHz; while (st.emb >= iv) { st.emb -= iv; spawnEmber(G, fs, st); } }   // kindling-r82 — the flight SPILLS its kindling: a coal every eiv ticks of flight (substep-exact)
      if (st.returns) {                                  // touchorbit-r53 THE WORLD ORBIT (the owner's prototype + the PURE-TOUCH ruling): the throw is an arena-centred ellipse, solved once at the throw and FROZEN — the loop lives in the WORLD, not on the wielder. It leaves, orbits (piercing the rim on its far arc) and comes back only when the wielder's motion intercepts it: the catch is an EVENT, not an invariant
        const om = st.speed / st.oa;                     // the constant parametric rate (the KEPLERIAN read: fastest at the near end — st.speed IS the periapsis peak — slowest at the far end, ×ob/oa). The birth-snapshot growth sits inside st.speed ⇒ each catch quickens the orbit (CYCLE-ONLY, unchanged)
        st.ot += st.osn * om * sdt;
        const cs = Math.cos(st.oph), sn = Math.sin(st.oph);
        const ex = st.oa * Math.cos(st.ot), ey = st.ob * Math.sin(st.ot);
        st.x = half + ex * cs - ey * sn; st.y = half + ex * sn + ey * cs;
        const tvx = -st.oa * Math.sin(st.ot), tvy = st.ob * Math.cos(st.ot);
        st.vx = (tvx * cs - tvy * sn) * st.osn * om; st.vy = (tvx * sn + tvy * cs) * st.osn * om;   // the true parametric velocity — the knock direction, the art facing and every velocity reader see the real motion
        st.arc += om * sdt;
        st.age += sdt;
      } else if (st.turn) {                              // any other curving row — the wand's BENT SPARK since bendspark-r61 (dormant since the pre-orbit boomerang retired): the constant-rate heading rotation, speed magnitude unchanged (the substep budget reads st.speed and never sees the bend)
        /* hexspark-r65 — THE HEX: the birth bend keeps authority (1−h), a SEEK authority h curves the
         * spark toward the hexed foe. h = min(own.shotStep, TURN_STEPS)/TURN_STEPS, LIVE — not frozen at
         * birth: when the hex deepens, ALL sparks in the air turn hostile at once (the snowball the owner
         * asked to SEE). AUTHORITY IS CONSERVED: |(1−h)·turn + h·|turn|·s| ≤ |turn| ≤ the r62 cap, so the
         * never-orbit law (333px radius floor — orbiting is the boomerang's soul) holds BY CONSTRUCTION,
         * and st.turn itself is never rewritten (frozen at birth, the r61 law). spellform-r69: h now has a
         * FLOOR (SEEK_H0 0.3) at the owner's flight-tuning ruling (*"i just want it to hit the opponent
         * more"*) — the h=0 byte-identity with the r62 bend is RETIRED BY THAT RULING (he owns the flight;
         * the wand bends and hunts with the family). NO new rng draws: the seek reads positions, so every
         * rng stream (the wand's included) stays untouched. */
        let tv = st.turn;
        if (st.hex) {
          const own = G.fighters[st.o];
          if (own) {
            const h = SEEK_H0 + (1 - SEEK_H0) * Math.min(own.shotStep, TURN_STEPS) / TURN_STEPS;   // spellform-r69: the seek floor — the grudge is born with the spell and deepens to full authority at the cap (SEEK_H0)
            if (h > 0) {
              const foe = G.fighters[1 - st.o];
              const err = Math.atan2(foe.pos.y - st.y, foe.pos.x - st.x) - Math.atan2(st.vy, st.vx);
              const ss = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, Math.atan2(Math.sin(err), Math.cos(err)) / SEEK_BAND));   // shortest-arc wrap + proportional inside the band
              tv = (1 - h) * st.turn + h * Math.abs(st.turn) * ss;
            }
          }
        }
        const ta = tv * sdt, tc = Math.cos(ta), ts = Math.sin(ta), nvx = st.vx * tc - st.vy * ts;
        st.vy = st.vx * ts + st.vy * tc; st.vx = nvx;
      }
      if (st.skewCarry) { const sv = st.skewVictim, k = sv.skew;
        if (k.phase === 'carry') {                           // the sinkalign-r50 SINK (owner: "it is already moving towards the centre of the bot… we can fix this by making it smooth"): the stuck spear slides from the impact point to the body centre on a SMOOTHSTEP of the carry progress (zero velocity at both ends — it sticks first, then buries). javelincarry-r52: the facing is NEVER touched here — vx/vy stay the throw's flight vector through the carry, the arrival and the drive (no turn to the rim; the r50 slerp/lerp turns are retired at the owner's eye)
          const a0 = Math.min(1, k.t / k.dur), a = a0 * a0 * (3 - 2 * a0);
          st.skewOx = k.ox0 * (1 - a); st.skewOy = k.oy0 * (1 - a);
          st.x = sv.pos.x + st.skewOx; st.y = sv.pos.y + st.skewOy;
        }                                                  // in the drive sub-phase skewStep owns the anchor's position (forward-only, into the rim)
      }
      else if (!st.pinned && !st.returns) { st.x += st.vx * sdt; st.y += st.vy * sdt; }   // pinlaw-r44: a nailed bolt is AT REST — its unit inward vx/vy is art facing and knock direction, not a velocity. touchorbit-r53: a returning shot's position IS the parametric orbit, written above — never double-integrated
      const foe = fs[1 - st.o];
      // rim first: the boundary is monotone for a straight-flying shot, so it can never tunnel
      const dxr = st.x - half, dyr = st.y - half;
      const dr = Math.hypot(dxr, dyr);
      if (!st.returns && !st.skewVictim && dr + st.r > half) {   // skewer-r46: an anchored javelin never dies at the rim — the carry rides the victim, the pin is snapped inside (a MISSED javelin still dies here, normally)              // r38: a returning shot PIERCES the rim (law 1's second row-owned exception after the shuriken's eternal ricochet) — it flies past the wall and comes home back through it
        if (st.ricochet) {                               // ricolaw-r41 (owner ruling 2026-11-01): a star NEVER dies at the rim — mirror-reflect forever at row speed. Only the foe's body, blade or shot ends the flight; the budget ("bounced once, then died") read as a bug at the eye
          const nx = dxr / dr, ny = dyr / dr, vn = st.vx * nx + st.vy * ny;
          st.vx -= 2 * vn * nx; st.vy -= 2 * vn * ny;
          st.x = half + nx * (half - st.r - 0.5); st.y = half + ny * (half - st.r - 0.5);
          emit(G, 'shotBounce', { by: st.o, sid: st.sid });
        } else if (st.pin) {                             // pinlaw-r44 (owner ruling 2026-11-01: "bolts stays pinned on the rim/edge of the arena, like nails, and when the opponents touch them, they get hit"): the rim NAILS the bolt instead of killing it — law 1's third row-owned exception
          const nx = dxr / dr, ny = dyr / dr;
          st.pinned = true;
          st.speed = 0;                              // the nail is AT REST, and the sim must not pay for it: the substep budget's worst-pair term (:1863) reads st.speed — without this, 400 static nails billed 860+860 px/s relative travel every tick and quintupled the substep count (the landing smoke's perf wall). Tunnel safety is untouched: a bolt approaching a nail budgets from the BOLT's own 860
          st.x = half + nx * (half - st.r - 0.5); st.y = half + ny * (half - st.r - 0.5);   // the ricochet's snap: rest just inside the rim, so a nail can never re-trigger the rim test
          st.pnx = -nx; st.pny = -ny;                  // pinfix-r45 (owner playtest eye-ruling: "the bolts flip around once they hit the edge/rim, dont do that"): the knock direction is STORED — vx/vy freeze as the impact flight line, so the drawn bolt keeps pointing into the wall like a real nail (head at the rim, shaft out) instead of spinning around to face the arena; shotHitBody reads pnx/pny for the knock (the impaled foe is still slammed inward, off the wall)
          emit(G, 'shotPin', { by: st.o, sid: st.sid, x: st.x, y: st.y, sr: st.r });   // a pin is NOT a departure (the ricochet/catch precedent): the nail is a shot AT REST — it ends on the foe's body (law-4 hit, consumed), the foe's blade (swat), an enemy shot (cross, returns included — the standard enemy-only cross law) or the roll-clear; the OWNER walks through his own nails (owner-blindness, game-wide since multgrow-r42)
        } else { killShot(G, st, 'rim', null, 0); continue; }
      }
      if (foe.alive) {
        const bx = foe.pos.x - st.x, by = foe.pos.y - st.y;
        const bd = Math.hypot(bx, by);
        let gap = bd - (CFG.bodyR + st.r);
        if (st.returns) { const ag = boomGap(G, st, foe.pos.x, foe.pos.y, CFG.bodyR); if (ag < gap) gap = ag; }   // chaosorbit-r54: the DRAWN ARC is the hitbox — the pivot disc alone let the eye watch a 100px arc sit inside a body with nothing dealt (owner catch, seed 3593)
        if (!st.skewVictim && gap < 0) {   // skewer-r46: an anchored javelin never re-hits the foe it impales — the first hit landed, the bleed does the rest
          if (!st.returns) {
            shotHitBody(G, fs, st, foe, bd);
            if (st.skewer && foe.alive && !foe.skew) { startSkewer(G, st, foe); shots[w++] = st; continue; }   // THE SKEWER
            // (skewer-r46): law 4's FOURTH row-owned exception — the hit does NOT consume the spear, it impales and CARRIES. A KILLING hit consumes normally (no corpse is dragged); an already-skewered foe takes the plain hit
            continue;                                   // consumed by the hit — law 4 for free
          }
          if (!st.latch) { shotHitBody(G, fs, st, foe, CFG.bodyR + st.r + gap); st.latch = 1; st.peak = 0; }   // r38 PASS-THROUGH (owner: "it will pass through"): damage + knock and it KEEPS FLYING — law 4's row-gated exception (hits do NOT grow: the catch-cycle is the growth trigger, owner ruling 2026-10-31). One hit per passage: the latch re-arms on deep clearance (the blade deep-gate idiom), so out-and-back can each land but a dragged contact cannot machine-gun. The synthetic bd keeps the hit event's gap field the TRUE surface gap when an arc tip lands the touch
        } else if (st.latch) {
          st.peak = Math.max(st.peak, gap);             // clearance past the touch window (arc-aware since chaosorbit-r54) — the latch re-arms at LATCH_CLEAR, so the NEXT visible passage through the body lands again
          if (st.peak >= LATCH_CLEAR) st.latch = 0;
        }
        if (st.pinned && st.skewVictim && st.skewVictim.skew && st.skewVictim.skew.cutArm) {   // skewer-r46 THE CUT-FREE WINDOW (the universal guarantee for all 22 rows) — naildrive-r49: it aims at the spear's ACTUAL position from the victim (right for the head-on pin and the grazing carry where the nail seats downrange); the physical circle swat below stays the literal truth where the chord geometry cooperates
          const vf = st.skewVictim;
          const wx = st.x - vf.pos.x, wy = st.y - vf.pos.y, wd = Math.hypot(wx, wy) || 1;
          if (vf.figT <= 0 && (Math.cos(vf.wAngle) * wx + Math.sin(vf.wAngle) * wy) / wd > SKEWER.cutCos) { killShot(G, st, 'swat', vf, 0); continue; }   // bloom-r73: a bloomed blade cuts no pin · the swat event names the victim as the swatter — their blade, their freedom
        }
        if (!st.returns && foe.figT <= 0) {   // bloom-r73: a bloomed blade swats nothing; catchonly-r56 — THE LOOP IS IMMUNE TO BLADES (owner: "i want the boomerang to be immune to swats"): no swat test runs on a returning shot; the drawn arc sails through foe blades like it sails through bodies, and ONLY the wielder's catch ends the flight
          const circ = bladeCircles(foe.pos.x, foe.pos.y, foe.wAngle, foe.weapon, CS, foe.fl.u, leadFlip(foe.weapon, foe.spin), foe.lenStep);
          let best = Infinity;
          for (let ci = 0; ci < circ.length; ci += 3) {
            const d = Math.hypot(st.x - circ[ci], st.y - circ[ci + 1]) - circ[ci + 2];
            if (d < best) best = d;
          }
          if (!st.skewCarry && best < st.r && (!st.skewVictim || !st.skewVictim.skew || st.skewVictim.skew.cutArm)) { killShot(G, st, 'swat', foe, best - st.r); continue; }   // the rule-5 exception: destroy, nothing else — skewer-r46: the CARRY is swat-exempt (the spear is INSIDE them); impale-r48: an anchored spear's physical swat obeys the SAME cutArm gate as the angle window — the blade must leave the wall window once before either path can cut (no instant escapes at arrival)
        }
      }
      if (st.returns) {                                  // catchonly-r56 — THE CATCH IS BACK (nocatch-r55 reverted at the owner's eye: "no it look bad, revert it"), and it is now the ONLY thing that ends a returning flight: the loop is IMMUNE to blades and to projectiles
        const own = fs[st.o];
        const dOwn = Math.hypot(own.pos.x - st.x, own.pos.y - st.y);
        if (!st.armed) {
          if (dOwn > CFG.bodyR + st.r + CATCH_ARM && boomGap(G, st, own.pos.x, own.pos.y, CFG.bodyR) > CATCH_ARM) st.armed = 1;   // catchonly-r56 THE ARC-AWARE ARM (owner heads-up: "the boomerang was immediately consumed when it was thrown"): the r54 arc catch window (~124px of reach) outgrew the disc-era arm margin (94px), so a throw could arm while its OWN drawn arc still overlapped the wielder and be caught on its departure tick. The throw must now clear the body with the ARC, by the same 20px margin, before the hand can catch it
        } else if (own.alive && own.figT <= 0 && Math.min(dOwn - (CFG.bodyR + st.r + CATCH_PAD), boomGap(G, st, own.pos.x, own.pos.y, CFG.bodyR + CATCH_PAD)) < 0) {   // bloom-r73: a bloomed hand catches nothing — the loop keeps its pure-touch orbit until the poof · chaosorbit-r54: PURE TOUCH reads the DRAWN ARC (boomCircles) — the loop is caught when what the eye sees touches the wielder's body, not when the invisible pivot disc does
          if (CATCH_GROW) own.shotStep++;                  // "each catch and throw makes it faster" (owner rulings 2026-10-31 + 2026-11-01): CYCLE-ONLY — the catch advances just the loop counter, deliberately NOT the full grow(); the cap still applies at READ time via CYCLE_STEPS
          killShot(G, st, 'catch', null, 0); continue;     // the rethrow revolution is banked inside killShot — RETHROW_WAIT 0 (instantthrow-r59): it leaves on the next substep; the continue drops the caught loop in this pass's compaction, so the singleton gate is already clear
        }
      }
      shots[w++] = st;
    }
    /* pinlaw-r44 perf surgery: partition the NAILS to the tail of the compacted window, then let
     * the outer loop BREAK at the first one — nail×nail pairs are exempt by law ("nails do not
     * fight nails"), so the outer pass only needs flier×flier and flier×nail: O(n²) → O(fliers×n)
     * at 444 nails, and the no-cap ruling stands. The swap partition is a no-op when nothing is
     * pinned (every non-crossbow cell keeps its exact shot order — bit-identical); among nails
     * the order shift is invisible (static art on the rim). */
    { let nMov = 0;
      for (let pi = 0; pi < w; pi++) if (!shots[pi].pinned) { const psw = shots[nMov]; shots[nMov] = shots[pi]; shots[pi] = psw; nMov++; } }
    for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) {                        // shot-vs-shot cancels both (owner rule)
      const A = shots[i];
      if (A.pinned) break;                               // pinlaw-r44: the tail is all nails — nail×nail is exempt by law, and flier×nail pairs were covered by the flier outer passes
      if (A.dead) continue;
      for (let j = i + 1; j < w; j++) {
        const B = shots[j];
        if (B.dead) continue;
        if (A.o === B.o) continue;   // multgrow-r42 (owner ruling 2026-11-01, option A "a, do that"): owner-blindness extends to shot-vs-shot — NO friendly fire, period. Subsumes ricolaw-r41's star-only exemption (same intent, now every shot class): the bow probe found cadence growth made consecutive launches self-annihilate under the old cross rule (~90% of fires at uncapped rate 1.0 died on the volley's own arrows). Enemy pairs still cancel both below below
        if (A.pinned && B.pinned) continue;   // pinlaw-r44: NAILS DO NOT FIGHT NAILS — a static pair can never visibly resolve, and two enemy bolts pinned side by side annihilating would read as a bug (the owner's own r41 bug-look doctrine); with the tail partition below this line is belt-and-braces — the outer loop breaks at the first nail, so nail×nail pairs are never even reached (the landing smoke found the O(n²) wall at 444+ nails; the no-cap ruling stands, the partition is the engineering answer). A nail still ends on a body, a blade, or an IN-FLIGHT enemy shot
        let xTouch;
        if (A.returns && B.returns) {   // catchghost-r58 (owner: "what happens if both bots have boomerang and they collide? i want them to both get destroyed"): loop meets loop is a normal cross again — r56's mutual pass REVERSED — and it triggers on the DRAWN ARCS (both hitboxes are their blade sweeps), arc circle against arc circle
          const BC = boomCircles(G, A, BOOM_CS), DC = boomCircles(G, B, BOOM_CS2);
          xTouch = Infinity;
          for (let ci = 0; ci < BC.length && xTouch >= 0; ci += 3) for (let cj = 0; cj < DC.length; cj += 3) { const d = Math.hypot(BC[ci] - DC[cj], BC[ci + 1] - DC[cj + 1]) - BC[ci + 2] - DC[cj + 2]; if (d < xTouch) xTouch = d; }
          xTouch = xTouch < 0;
        } else if (A.returns || B.returns) {   // snapfix-r57: the projectile breaks on the DRAWN ARC (the hitbox doctrine), not on the invisible pivot disc — review-r60: routed through boomGap, the identical min-over-circles expression the body test and the catch already use
          const L = A.returns ? A : B, P = A.returns ? B : A;
          xTouch = boomGap(G, L, P.x, P.y, P.r) < 0;
        } else xTouch = Math.hypot(A.x - B.x, A.y - B.y) < A.r + B.r;
        if (xTouch) {
          if ((A.returns || B.returns) && !(A.returns && B.returns)) {   // snapfix-r57 (owner: "i want other projectiles hitting the boomerang to be destroyed, but not the boomerang"): the PROJECTILE dies on the loop and the loop flies on — the immunity is one-sided now; catchghost-r58: a boomerang PAIR falls through to the shared both-die cross below
            const dead = A.returns ? B : A;
            dead.dead = true;
            killShot(G, dead, 'cross', null, 0);
            if (dead === A) break;   // A is gone — the inner loop is over for it (the double-kill guard's spirit: a dead shot never tests again this tick)
            continue;                // B died on the loop: the loop keeps testing the rest of the window this tick
          }
          A.dead = true; B.dead = true;
          killShot(G, A, 'cross', null, 0); killShot(G, B, 'cross', null, 0);
          /* break (2026-10-28, owner go) — without it the inner loop keeps testing the now-dead A
           * against later shots, so killShot(A,'cross') fires twice: a duplicate shotCross event
           * and a double G.stats.crossed++. Measured on the 484-cell baseline: 3 in 415,580 shots,
           * all boomerang cells — the roster's largest shot (r 10) and its only curving one
           * (turn 2.6), so a returning boomerang meets a freshly launched one. DISCLOSED trade-off:
           * A now cancels ONE opponent per tick, so a third shot touching only the dead A survives
           * (it did not before). Law 4s caught this exactly as designed; the defect was here, not
           * in measure.mjs's addGone, which already dedupes and reports. */
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    let m = 0;                                           // drop the cross casualties
    for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) {
      if (shots[i].dead) continue;
      shots[m++] = shots[i];
    }
    shots.length = m;
  }

   * verbatim silhouettes + covering circles from the same data), so drawing

  const COLS = ['#a8892f', '#ff6b4a'];        // Speedy, Heavy — cast colors: identical in every theme (identity is permanent)
  const HP_FONT = '800 ' + Math.round(CFG.bodyR * 0.62) + 'px ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace';   // bodyR is a constant — build the font string once

  /* Channel theme — LOCKED: PEBBLE (owner decision, 2026-10-15). Winner of

  const TH = {
    floor: '#e7dfca',
    card: { text: '#2e2b22' },   // in-arena type colors (no plates)
    botInk: '#2e2b22', hpText: '#15140e',

  /* Rim — LOCKED: Hairline (owner, 2026-10-15, cut two). The toggle and the

  const WALL = { t: 12, body: '#a99f86', dark: '#8d8369' };


  /* ---- weapon actors: drawn from their own collision polygons ---- */
  function polyPath(g, pl, ox, oy, c, s, fp, W) {
    const m = fp === undefined ? 1 : fp;   // edge-leading/head-leading factor — the SIM-side callers and every audit pass exactly ±1 (×1 exact); the art pass may pass the flip transition's continuous value (owner decision 2026-10-22: art eases old→edge-on→mirrored over CFG.flipMs while the hitbox is already at its new true pose — the disclosed, owner-accepted trade; the hitbox overlay and the stills always draw the binary truth)
    const hd = W && W.headLead !== undefined, h = hd ? W.len / 2 : 0;   // W carries the mirror axis: lead scales l, headLead pivots d about the centred grip (javelin)
    g.beginPath();
    for (const pts of pl.subs) {                        // subpath groups: holes stay holes
      for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
        let d = pts[i][0], l = pts[i][1];
        if (m !== 1) { if (hd) d = h + (d - h) * m; else l = l * m; }
        const X = ox + c * d - s * l, Y = oy + s * d + c * l;
        if (i) g.lineTo(X, Y); else g.moveTo(X, Y);
      }
      g.closePath();
    }
  }
  const sigilFill = (fill, acc, ov) => ov || (fill === KC ? (acc || KG) : fill);   // the ONE sigil swap: KC-tagged shapes wear the carrier's cast colour (KG gold for carrier-less callers); an override wins
  function drawWeapon(g, W, ox, oy, ang, fillOverride, fp, acc, polys) {
    const c = Math.cos(ang), s = Math.sin(ang);
    /* polys = an optional pre-mapped poly set — the length-growth ladder's entry for this
     * fighter's step. Passing the SET rather than a step number keeps the renderer free of sim
     * state, and the ladder's sets are built once at boot, so this allocates nothing per frame.
     * Undefined/step 0 draws the weapon's own shipped polys, byte-for-byte as before. */
    const PS = polys || W.poly.polys;
    // ink pass first: the outline's outer half IS part of the body.
    /* NOTE (2026-10-19, RESOLVED): the inscribe audit (.qa/ko-frame-recon.svg
     * evidence, seed-63230 K.O. frame) proved the shipped coverings poked past
     * their own ink — hammer +13.6px (the gap the owner spotted), axe +8.5,
     * bow +2.0, dagger +1.5, cover()-batch +0.1..0.26 — and left ink uncovered
     * (misses to 13.1px): hits were legal in circle-space while the inks were
     * apart. Owner directive 2026-10-19: "this should be a top priority to
     * always make weapons visibly touch something else before something
     * happens, like nobody wants to see parry fire or body taking damage when
     * there is a visible gap between etc". Fix: CIRCLES_V2 — every covering
     * regenerated union-inscribed in THIS drawing's ink (.qa/inscribe.mjs
     * --regen), gated by the same script after any art edit. Events now fire
     * only on visible contact; disclosed whiff: outer 0.3px band + tips. */
    g.lineJoin = 'round';
    g.lineWidth = 3;
    g.strokeStyle = fillOverride || TH.botInk;
    for (const pl of PS) { polyPath(g, pl, ox, oy, c, s, fp, W); g.stroke(); }
    for (const pl of PS) {
      polyPath(g, pl, ox, oy, c, s, fp, W);
      g.fillStyle = sigilFill(pl.fill, acc, fillOverride);
      g.fill('evenodd');
    }
  }
  /* FLAIL (2026-10-22): the articulated draw — same ink-then-fill passes as drawWeapon, but every shape rides the
   * frame of ITS segment (chainFrames, the one placement the hitbox also uses); fl = the chain pose to draw. */
  function drawWeaponChain(g, W, fr, fl, fillOverride, acc, mul) {
    const ch = W.chain;
    chainFrames(fr, ch, fl, mul);
    g.lineJoin = 'round';
    g.lineWidth = 3;
    g.strokeStyle = fillOverride || TH.botInk;
    for (let i = 0; i < W.poly.polys.length; i++) {
      const k = ch.segOfShape[i], c = CF_C[k], s = CF_S[k];
      polyPath(g, W.poly.polys[i], CF_X[k] - c * ch.dj[k], CF_Y[k] - s * ch.dj[k], c, s); g.stroke();
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < W.poly.polys.length; i++) {
      const k = ch.segOfShape[i], c = CF_C[k], s = CF_S[k];
      polyPath(g, W.poly.polys[i], CF_X[k] - c * ch.dj[k], CF_Y[k] - s * ch.dj[k], c, s);
      g.fillStyle = sigilFill(W.poly.polys[i].fill, acc, fillOverride);
      g.fill('evenodd');
    }
  }
  function drawWeaponOn(g, wId, x, y, ang, fillOverride, fl, fp, acc, ls) {
    const fr = spineFrame(x, y, ang, wId);         // the placement the collision sees — the drawing cannot drift from the hitbox
    if (fl && WEAPONS[wId].chain) { drawWeaponChain(g, WEAPONS[wId], fr, fl, fillOverride, acc, chainGrow(wId, ls)); return; }
    /* ls = the fighter's length-growth step. The drawing takes the SAME ladder entry the
     * collision reads in bladeCircles, which is the invariant this function exists to hold:
     * the art cannot drift from the hitbox. Step 0 / no ladder draws the shipped polys. */
    const L = ls ? LEN_LADDER[wId] : null;
    drawWeapon(g, WEAPONS[wId], fr.ox, fr.oy, Math.atan2(fr.dy, fr.dx), fillOverride, fp, acc, L ? L.polys[ls] : null);
  }
  /* Legend shorthand is AUTHORED per row (`short`), never derived. It used to be
   * `f.skill.spin ? '+SPD' : '+DMG'` — a binary test that silently prints a WRONG label for any
   * third axis: Heavy's lenSteps would have shipped as '+DMG / Hit' with no mention of length.
   * Owner ruling: authored legend labels. Guarded at boot so no fighter can ship unlabelled. */
  for (const f of FIGHTERS) if (!f.short) throw new Error(`${f.id}: FIGHTERS row has no authored \`short\` legend label — SKILL_SHORT is authored, never derived`);
  const SKILL_SHORT = FIGHTERS.map(f => f.short);
  const TINTS = ['#4a3b12', '#6f2818'];   // deep tints for ALL type — >=4.5:1 on page taupe AND cream; raw colors are actors/fills only
  const PLATE = TH.floor;                 // arena cream — the VS poster's plate colour (owner reveal design, 2026-10-19)
  const clamp01 = (v) => (v < 0 ? 0 : v > 1 ? 1 : v);

  /* Reveal-only weapon fitter (owner's VS poster, 2026-10-19): draws weapon
   * id centred at (cx, cy), tilted rot, scaled to fit a maxW × maxH box (sc
   * multiplies the fit). alpha multiplies the caller's globalAlpha; tint runs
   * through drawWeapon's fillOverride (silhouette mode); flip mirrors on x.
   * Bounds are cached from the same poly data the collision covering reads —
   * renderer-side only, the sim never sees this. */
  const FITB = {};
  function fitBounds(id) {
    if (FITB[id]) return FITB[id];
    let d0 = Infinity, d1 = -Infinity, l0 = Infinity, l1 = -Infinity;
    for (const pl of WEAPONS[id].poly.polys) for (const pts of pl.subs) for (const pt of pts) {
      d0 = Math.min(d0, pt[0]); d1 = Math.max(d1, pt[0]);
      l0 = Math.min(l0, pt[1]); l1 = Math.max(l1, pt[1]);
    }
    return FITB[id] = { w: d1 - d0 || 1, h: l1 - l0 || 1, cd: (d0 + d1) / 2, cl: (l0 + l1) / 2 };
  }
  function drawFitWeapon(id, cx, cy, rot, maxW, maxH, sc, alpha, tint, flip, acc) {
    const b = fitBounds(id);
    const k = Math.min(maxW / b.w, maxH / b.h);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha *= alpha;
    ctx.translate(cx, cy); ctx.rotate(rot);
    ctx.scale((flip ? -1 : 1) * k * sc, k * sc);
    drawWeapon(ctx, WEAPONS[id], -b.cd, -b.cl, 0, tint || undefined, undefined, acc);   // the reveal has carriers: the poster's sigils wear the half's ACTOR colour COLS[G.cast[i]], never the gold fallback (owner 2026-10-27)
    ctx.restore();
  }

  const flashV = [0, 0];

  /* Edge-leading flip transition state (owner decision 2026-10-22 — replaces

  let banner = null;   // { text, t } — round banner (phase announcement)
  /* K.O. kill still (owner decision 2026-10-19, option 1): the killing blow's

  let koStill = null;
  /* Hit still — superseded for non-kill hits (owner 2026-10-27), and since
   * slowmo-r63 (owner 2026-11-02) their beat is not even a pause: non-kill
   * hits open a brief SLOW-MOTION window — the world keeps living at ¼×, so
   * there is nothing to latch and nothing to hold; only the kill still
   * (koStill, 2026-10-19 — the kill beat KEPT its hard freeze at the same r63
   * ruling) latches contact poses. History and the traded guarantee:
   * GAMES.md, dmg1-r21 entry. The non-kill latch machinery is gone. */
  /* sid → the shot object as last drawn — flight state (kind/vx/vy/len) for
   * re-drawing a projectile that died on the killing tick; the impact point
   * itself comes from the event (sx, sy), not from this map. Bolts fly
   * straight, so the last-seen velocity IS the impact velocity. */
  const lastShots = new Map();
  const sparkTrail = new Map();   // hexspark-r65: sid -> comet-trail record (renderer-only; cleared with lastShots at rolls and in resetFx)
  /* Catch ghosts (catchghost-r58): a caught loop is consumed by the sim at the touch point, but
   * the EYE must see it come home — the last-drawn flight state slides from the catch point into
   * the wielder's grip over CGHOST_T ticks (ease-in: pulled into the hand). Renderer sugar only;
   * slot-keyed, idempotent per event (consumeEvents may re-run per frame). */
  const catchFx = [null, null];
  const CGHOST_T = Math.round(0.25 * CFG.tickHz);
  function resetFx() { flashV[0] = 0; flashV[1] = 0; poisonPulse[0] = 0; poisonPulse[1] = 0; flipAnim[0].t = 0; flipAnim[0].cur = 1; flipAnim[0].snap = true; flipAnim[1].t = 0; flipAnim[1].cur = 1; flipAnim[1].snap = true; banner = null; koStill = null; lastShots.clear(); sparkTrail.clear(); catchFx[0] = null; catchFx[1] = null; }   // flip transitions snap at round rolls — a new weapon materialises in its canonical orientation, it never flips in
  function consumeEvents(G) {
    for (const e of G.events) {
      if (e.kind === 'bleedTick') { flashV[e.to] = 1; continue; }
      if (e.kind === 'poisonTick') { poisonPulse[e.to] = 1; continue; }
      if (e.kind === 'emberPop') {   // emberfix-r85 — THE POP GETS THE HIT'S OWN PUNCTUATION (owner: *"i think we should have the slowmo effect, i forgot to write that it wasnt present"*): the bite flashes its victim and opens the ¼× window on the hit's own merge semantics (refresh, never stack); a pop KILL takes the KO hard freeze
        flashV[e.to] = 1;
        if (e.kill) {
          const want = CFG.koStopMs * CFG.tickHz / 1000;
          if (want > stopTicks) stopTicks = want;
          slowTicks = 0;
        } else {
          const want = CFG.hitSlowMs * CFG.tickHz / 1000;
          if (want > slowTicks) slowTicks = want;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (e.kind === 'poolBurn' && e.kill) {   // emberfix-r85 — a burn KILL punches the KO beat too (every killing blow freezes, the r63 ruling; no koStill latch — the world holds its last drawn frame, the true-pause semantics). The NON-KILL burn beats deliberately do NOT slow: at the 0.1s cadence a burn slow would never lift
        const want = CFG.koStopMs * CFG.tickHz / 1000;
        if (want > stopTicks) stopTicks = want;
        slowTicks = 0;
        continue;
      }   // affinity-r66: the venom bite pulses the RING, not the white body flash — the beat IS the DoT read (ring grammar: pulse = tempo)   // skewer-r46: the bleed pulse wears the hit flash but NOT the hitstop — freezing the world every 0.43s would stutter the struggle
      if (e.kind === 'hit') {
        flashV[e.to] = 1;
        /* Hit beat — trigger policy 1 (owner decision 2026-10-19: "implement
         * it, and do 1 trigger policy"): EVERY damage hit punches the world;
         * the killing blow gets the long beat. Parry/wall/bounce never stop
         * time (no damage); bleed pulses skip the beat entirely (skewer-r46 —
         * a stuttering struggle). slowmo-r63 (owner 2026-11-02: "i want to
         * change hitstop to do a brief slowmotion instead, hitstop seems laggy
         * sometimes, when quick multiple hits occur"; and "keep ko hard
         * freeze"): the non-kill punch is a SLOW-MOTION WINDOW — the world
         * keeps living at hitSlowRate for hitSlowMs instead of freezing, so
         * queued contacts RESOLVE inside the beat (in slow motion) instead of
         * re-freezing it on lift. Windows MAX-merge, never stack — a hit in
         * slow refreshes the window; a dense exchange is one sustained
         * intensity slow, the slideshow class is structurally gone. The kill
         * stays a HARD FREEZE — terminal punctuation with nothing chaining
         * after it, and the koStill latch + winner overlay are built around
         * the hold. */
        if (e.kill) {
          const want = CFG.koStopMs * CFG.tickHz / 1000;
          if (want > stopTicks) stopTicks = want;
          slowTicks = 0;   // the KO beat supersedes any running hit-slow — the freeze gates everything anyway and the round is ending
        } else {
          const want = CFG.hitSlowMs * CFG.tickHz / 1000;
          if (want > slowTicks) slowTicks = want;   // refresh, never stack
        }
        // white weapon-silhouette ghosts retired by owner decision 2026-10-18;
        // the struck body's white flash remains the hit's on-screen proof
        /* Kill-still latch: CONTACT poses straight off the event — victim at
         * (x, y); blade killer at (ax, ay, aAng); a landing shot frozen at
         * (sx, sy) with its last-drawn flight state, or the never-drawn
         * fallback disc. Non-kill hits latch nothing: their freeze is a true
         * pause (owner 2026-10-27). Same-tick double kills merge per slot. */
        const target = e.kill ? (koStill ||= { pose: [null, null], shot: null }) : null;   // non-kill: NO latch — the freeze is a true pause (owner 2026-10-27); the hitStill override was the only motion inside the window
        if (target) target.pose[e.to] = { x: e.x, y: e.y };
        if (!target) { /* true pause: nothing latches, the freeze holds the on-screen frame */ } else if (e.shot) {
          const seen = lastShots.get(e.sid);
          target.shot = seen
            ? Object.assign({}, seen, { x: e.sx, y: e.sy })     // flight state as last drawn, impact point exact
            : { kind: 'shot', r: e.sr, x: e.sx, y: e.sy };   // never-drawn fallback (fired AND landed inside one tick): plain shot disc at the impact point — drawShot's generic branch
          target.pose[e.by] = null;                            // a shooter's own pose is irrelevant — it never touched anything
        } else {
          target.pose[e.by] = { x: e.ax, y: e.ay, ang: e.aAng, fl: e.aFl, fp: leadFlip(e.aW, e.aSp) };   // + the attacker's chain pose (flail) and edge-leading mirror (katana/scythe — derived from the event's signed spin) so the still shows the real touch
        }
      }
      // swat ghosts retired with the rest (owner decision 2026-10-18); the swat stays physical and audited
      // parry ghosts retired by owner decision 2026-10-18 (parry stays physical: recoil + shove)
      // parry needs no branch here: the edge-leading flip TRANSITION is driven
      // off the view build (it watches for the latest tick's spin sign to
      // disagree with the displayed factor), so it arms on the first drawn
      // frame after the recoil — no event plumbing. (The glint that lived here
      // was replaced by the transition at owner word, 2026-10-22.)
      // 'ko' needs no branch: only a killing 'hit' ends a life, same tick and
      // earlier in this array — the loser's flash is already set above
      else if (e.kind === 'shotCatch' && e.cw === 'boom') {   // catchghost-r58: latch the settle ghost — catch point off the event, flight state off the last-drawn record
        const rec = lastShots.get(e.sid);
        catchFx[e.by] = { x0: e.x, y0: e.y, t: G.t, st: rec ? Object.assign({}, rec) : null };
      }
      else if (e.kind === 'roundStart') banner = { text: e.round === 3 ? 'ROUND 3 · DECIDER' : 'ROUND ' + e.round, t: 0 };
    }
  }

  /* ---- canvas + pre-rendered arena ---- */
  const cv = document.getElementById('c');
  const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  const wrapEl = document.getElementById('wrap');
  /* Overflow band (owner 2026-10-21: "i want to see the weapons go out of
   * bounds instead of going under the rim", arena kept at approved size):
   * ONE canvas, sized square + band, absolutely centred over its cssPx
   * layout box — tips that poke past the square (worst ~146 units: long
   * radial tip, body at the rim) stay whole instead of cutting at the old
   * canvas edge, which at the four axis directions coincides with the rim's
   * outer edge and read as the weapon dipping UNDER the rim. History: a
   * margin-band zoom (smaller disc) was rejected ("something is off"); then
   * a second band canvas met the main one at a fractional CSS offset whose
   * device-pixel grid disagreed with it — the joint read as a line across
   * the ink (owner: "you can see the line"). One backing store, one grid:
   * no seam class. Disc scale U, page flow and chrome untouched; the band
   * overhangs the chrome rows (pointer-transparent; extreme top/bottom tips
   * draw over scorebug/legend — disclosed spectacle). Renderer-only; the
   * sim never knows. */
  const OV_MARGIN = 150;
  let OUT = 0, U = 1, OV_OFF = 0, arenaCv = null;

  function buildArena() {
    arenaCv = document.createElement('canvas');
    arenaCv.width = arenaCv.height = cv.width;
    const g = arenaCv.getContext('2d');
    g.setTransform(U, 0, 0, U, OV_OFF, OV_OFF);   // the square sits centred in the band canvas
    const C = CFG.size / 2;
    // locked rim: mid-taupe band with a dark hairline at its outer edge
    g.strokeStyle = WALL.body; g.lineWidth = WALL.t;
    g.beginPath(); g.arc(C, C, C - WALL.t / 2, 0, TAU); g.stroke();
    g.strokeStyle = WALL.dark; g.lineWidth = 2;
    g.beginPath(); g.arc(C, C, C - 1, 0, TAU); g.stroke();
    g.fillStyle = TH.floor;
    g.beginPath(); g.arc(C, C, C - WALL.t, 0, TAU); g.fill();
  }

  function resize() {
    const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    const cssPx = Math.max(280, Math.min(720, (window.innerWidth || 744) - 24, (window.innerHeight || 900) - 235));
    OUT = Math.round(cssPx * dpr);
    U = OUT / CFG.size;                       // disc scale: the approved framing, untouched by the band
    /* one backing store, one pixel grid: the canvas is the square plus the
     * band, absolutely centred over its cssPx layout box (the wrap keeps the
     * flow height; the band overhangs into the chrome rows, pointer-transparent) */
    const bandCss = OV_MARGIN * cssPx / CFG.size;
    const bandDev = Math.round(bandCss * dpr);
    OV_OFF = bandDev;
    cv.width = cv.height = OUT + 2 * bandDev;
    const canvasCss = cssPx + 2 * bandCss;
    cv.style.width = cv.style.height = canvasCss + 'px';
    wrapEl.style.height = cssPx + 'px';
    cv.style.left = (((wrapEl.clientWidth || cssPx) - canvasCss) / 2) + 'px';
    cv.style.top = (-bandCss) + 'px';
    buildArena();
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  /* ---- app state ---- */
  let paused = false, slow = false, fast = false, showHitbox = false;
  let ACC_OVERRIDE = null;   // arena review accent (ACC chip): the sigil swap reads this before the carrier color
  let seed = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e5);
  let CAST_OVERRIDE = null;   // pairing lever (pair-r31): APP.setCast([i, j]) chooses the next battle's cast; null = the shipped default
  const castOpts = () => (CAST_OVERRIDE ? { cast: CAST_OVERRIDE } : undefined);
  let G = newGame(seed, castOpts());

  function restart(s) {
    if (s !== undefined && s !== null) seed = s >>> 0;
    G = newGame(seed, castOpts());
    resetFx();
    tickAcc = 0;
    stopTicks = 0;
    slowTicks = 0;   // slowmo-r63: a restart must never carry a slow window into the fresh battle
  }

  /* ---- drawing ---- */
  /* v0.8-step1b (owner decision 2026-10-18): bodies and weapons are separate
   * passes — every weapon draws ABOVE every body, so a blade never disappears
   * under the opponent's disc. Spin trails and ALL contact-pose ghosts are
   * retired (owner decisions 2026-10-18); the struck-body white flash is the
   * frame's only hit punctuation, and proof-of-contact lives in the harness. */
  /* v0.8.2 render interpolation: every actor draws at a pose BLENDED between
   * the last two tick poses (prev saved at tick start in stepPhysics; alpha =
   * viewA = leftover tick fraction, set in the frame loop). vx/vy/va are the
   * blended body centre and weapon angle; the sim's f.pos/f.wAngle stay the
   * exact tick poses the laws use. Pattern from sumo_war (2).html. */
  function drawBody(f, vx, vy) {
    const col = COLS[f.idx];
    const al = f.alive ? 1 : 0.5;
    ctx.globalAlpha = al;
    // disc + ink border
    ctx.fillStyle = col;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx, vy, CFG.bodyR, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = TH.botInk; ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx, vy, CFG.bodyR, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
    // hit flash: bright white overlay — tells the viewer who just got hit
    const fl = flashV[f.slot];   // flashV is fed by the hit event's `to`, which is a slot
    if (fl > 0.01) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = al * Math.min(1, fl) * 0.9;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx, vy, CFG.bodyR, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
    /* affinity-r66 — THE STATUS RINGS (the owner's grammar: ONE design, fixed inside-out slots —
     * DoT tight against the body (it is eating him), the curse band outside it, the buff slot
     * outermost (RESERVED — healing comes later). Colour = WHICH status (poison green KP1, frost
     * blue KN1 — the shipped affinity tints); thickness + stand-off = DEPTH (stacks/cap); pulse =
     * TEMPO, and debuffs beat HARD and INWARD: the venom ring tightens as the next bite winds up
     * (d.acc is the anticipation) and snaps bright on the tick (poisonPulse), the chill ring drags
     * on a slow heavy beat. At the cap the ring gains the inner bleed — the MAXED flourish (the hex
     * precedent). Renderer-only: the sim never reads this. */
    const pd = f.alive ? f.dot : null;
    if (pd && pd.k === 'poison') {
      const hn = pd.n / TRIO.steps;
      const beat = poisonPulse[f.slot];
      const wind = pd.acc / TRIO.poisonEvery;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = KP1;
      ctx.globalAlpha = al * Math.min(1, 0.30 + 0.45 * hn + 0.5 * beat);
      ctx.lineWidth = 2 + 5 * hn + 2 * beat;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx, vy, CFG.bodyR + 4 + 2 * hn - (2 + 2 * hn) * wind - 2.5 * beat, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
      if (pd.n >= TRIO.steps) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = al * (0.35 + 0.3 * beat);
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx, vy, CFG.bodyR + 1.5, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
    const ch = f.alive ? f.chill : null;
    if (ch) {
      const hn = ch.n / TRIO.steps;
      const drag = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(G.phaseT * 0.07);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = KN1;
      ctx.globalAlpha = al * (0.30 + 0.45 * hn);
      ctx.lineWidth = 2 + 4 * hn;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx, vy, CFG.bodyR + 9 + 3 * hn - 2 * drag * (0.5 + hn), 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
      if (ch.n >= TRIO.steps) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = al * 0.4;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx, vy, CFG.bodyR + 1.5, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
    /* hexspark-r65 → hexfam-r68 — THE HEX MARK: the victim WEARS the caster's growth counter. Every spell hit
     * that lands on him deepens the hex (the attacker's f.shotStep, capped at TURN_STEPS like every growth axis —
     * and since the family ruling ANY shot.hex attacker marks, in their own cast colour), and
     * the mark says so across the arena: a pulsing ring in the ATTACKER's colour — "his magic is on you" —
     * thickening and standing off with the stacks, plus an inner bleed past half. The pulse rides G.phaseT:
     * the curse's heartbeat throbs inside the slow-mo window and freezes with the KO hold, like every other
     * world FX. Renderer-only — the sim never reads this. */
    const hexer = f.alive ? G.fighters[1 - f.slot] : null;
    const hexW = hexer && hexer.weapon ? WEAPONS[hexer.weapon] : null;
    if (hexW && hexW.shot && hexW.shot.hex && hexer.shotStep > 0) {
      const hh = Math.min(hexer.shotStep, TURN_STEPS) / TURN_STEPS;
      const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(G.phaseT * 0.15);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = COLS[hexer.idx];
      ctx.globalAlpha = al * (0.30 + 0.45 * hh);
      ctx.lineWidth = 2 + 4 * hh;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx, vy, CFG.bodyR + 5 + 3 * hh + 2 * pulse * hh, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
      if (hh > 0.5) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = al * (hh - 0.5) * (0.5 + 0.3 * pulse);
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx, vy, CFG.bodyR + 1.5, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
    // HP number — centred: the only thing inside the bot
    ctx.fillStyle = TH.hpText;
    ctx.font = HP_FONT;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(String(Math.max(0, Math.ceil(f.hp))), vx, vy + CFG.bodyR * 0.04);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawWeaponOf(g, f, fightPop, vx, vy, va, vfl, vfp) {
    if (!f.weapon || fightPop <= 0 || !f.alive) return;   // the dead keep no weapon on the frozen K.O. frame — the faded disc is the death mark
    /* catchghost-r58 (owner, on r57's empty hand: "the wielding boomerang is invisible, it should
     * be, fix it"): the held art is drawn ALWAYS — r57's flight/hand-rest skip is withdrawn. The
     * catch's teleport-read (r56 eye: the loop vanished at its touch point while the held copy
     * stayed at the grip) is fixed on the OTHER side instead: a render-only ghost rides the caught
     * arc home — consumeEvents latches the catch point + last-drawn flight state, and draw() slides
     * it into the grip over CGHOST_T ticks, so the eye watches the boomerang come to hand. */
    g.globalAlpha = 1;
    // weapon actor — the collision silhouette's own shape, at the blended render pose
    const fr = spineFrame(vx, vy, va, f.weapon);
    const pc = POPC[f.weapon];                   // pop-in scales around the silhouette's centre
    let wd = pc ? pc.d : fr.span / 2, wl = pc ? pc.l : 0;
    const vfm = vfp === undefined ? 1 : vfp;
    if (vfm !== 1) { if (WEAPONS[f.weapon].headLead !== undefined) { const h = WEAPONS[f.weapon].len / 2; wd = h + (wd - h) * vfm; } else wl = wl * vfm; }   // the pop centre rides the same mirror as the art (the placement layer's exact formula, per axis)
    const wx = fr.ox + fr.dx * wd - fr.dy * wl;
    const wy = fr.oy + fr.dy * wd + fr.dx * wl;
    const pop = Math.min(1, fightPop);
    if (f.figT > 0) {   // bloom-r73 — TRANSFIGURED: the weapon IS the joke object, flopping on the swing (a wet-noodle head lag against the sweep)
      const fo = FIGOBJS[f.figObj % FIGOBJS.length];
      g.save();
      g.globalAlpha = 1;
      // bloomfix-r74 (owner eye: *"i dont want it to be air between, i want whatever the weapons turn into, should touch the body"*):
      // the joke object rides at the GRIP — centre 0.45 radii out along the swing, inner edge on the hand, so it TOUCHES the body
      g.translate(fr.ox + fr.dx * fo[0] * 0.45, fr.oy + fr.dy * fo[0] * 0.45);
      g.rotate(va);   // bloomfix-r76 (owner: *"they should not spin around itself, just rotate around the body as a normal weapon"*) — the object's angle IS the swing angle, tangential, exactly like a held weapon; the r75 slow own-turn is gone
      g.lineJoin = 'round';
      for (const sh of fo[1]) {
        g.fillStyle = sh[0];
        g.strokeStyle = '#3a2a1a';
        g.lineWidth = 1.5;
        g.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i < sh[1].length; i++) {
          const pt = sh[1][i];
          if (i === 0) g.moveTo(pt[0] * fo[0], pt[1] * fo[0]);
          else g.lineTo(pt[0] * fo[0], pt[1] * fo[0]);
        }
        g.closePath();
        g.fill();
        g.stroke();
      }
      g.restore();
      return;
    }
    if (f.figPoof > 0) {   // bloom-r73 — THE POOF: one tiny cream ring at the grip as the joke leaves (20 ticks, fade + grow)
      const pk = f.figPoof / FIG.poof;
      g.save();
      g.globalAlpha = 0.55 * pk;
      g.strokeStyle = '#f4efdf';
      g.lineWidth = 2;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(fr.ox + fr.dx * 40, fr.oy + fr.dy * 40, 6 + (1 - pk) * 24, 0, Math.PI * 2);   // bloomfix-r74: the poof rings at the grip, where the object sat
      g.stroke();
      g.restore();
    }
    g.save();
    /* tuck (owner decision 2026-10-18): the grip tip never draws over the
     * own disc — clip the own body circle out of the weapon pass. Detail
     * budget belongs from the guard outwards.
     * DERIVED 2026-10-28 (authoring-scale pass item 2): a TANGENTIAL chord
     * never tucks — its midpoint sits on the rim and its art straddles it, so
     * the clip would notch the weapon — which is why all 9 tangential rows used
     * to repeat `tuck: false`. That is now read off `hold`, so a new tangential
     * weapon cannot get it wrong; only handle-less RADIAL art still opts out by
     * name (the orb, whose sphere floats 46.8px clear of the rim — a no-op
     * clip today, kept declared in case its art ever grows inward). The clip
     * can never hide a hitbox: ink at r <= bodyR from the own centre cannot be
     * inside the opponent's disc at any legal separation (centres are 2 x bodyR
     * apart at contact). */
    if (WEAPONS[f.weapon].tuck !== false && WEAPONS[f.weapon].hold !== 'tangential') {
      g.beginPath();
      g.rect(vx - 600, vy - 600, 1200, 1200);
      g.arc(vx, vy, CFG.bodyR, 0, TAU);
      g.clip('evenodd');
    }
    g.translate(wx, wy);
    g.scale(pop, pop);
    g.translate(-wx, -wy);
    drawWeaponOn(g, f.weapon, vx, vy, va, undefined, vfl, vfp, COLS[f.idx], f.lenStep);   // the sigil wears the carrier's cast color
    g.restore();   // save/restore owns globalAlpha — the entry already set it to 1, so no post-restore reset is needed
  }

  function drawHitboxes(g, view) {
    // red silhouettes = the drawn weapon = the collision envelope; gold dots =
    // the literal covering circles the sim tests (they ride ≤0.3px inside the
    // red); blue = the body circle. All three come from the same poly data.
    // v0.8.2: the overlay rides the SAME interpolated pose as the art (so red
    // never drifts off the drawn weapon); the laws are still audited at exact
    // tick poses by measure.mjs, which never renders.
    g.save();
    for (const f of G.fighters) {
      if (!f.alive || !f.weapon || f.figT > 0) continue;   // bloom-r73 — a bloomed weapon draws no weapon chrome (the joke object wears it)
      const v = view[f.slot];
      drawWeaponOn(g, f.weapon, v.x, v.y, v.ang, 'rgba(255,70,70,0.35)', v.fl, v.fpSim, COLS[f.idx], f.lenStep);   // the overlay draws SIM TRUTH (the binary flip), never the transition's squash — debug shows what collides
      const circ = bladeCircles(v.x, v.y, v.ang, f.weapon, f.slot === 0 ? C0 : C1, v.fl, v.fpSim, f.lenStep);
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,150,0,0.9)';
      for (let i = 0; i < circ.length; i += 3) {
        g.beginPath(); g.arc(circ[i], circ[i + 1], 1.6, 0, TAU); g.fill();
      }
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,110,190,0.8)';
      g.beginPath(); g.arc(v.x, v.y, CFG.bodyR, 0, TAU); g.stroke();
    }
    for (const st of G.shots) {                         // shot hitbox = the same circle, shown red like every collision shape
      const sx = st.px + (st.x - st.px) * viewA, sy = st.py + (st.y - st.py) * viewA;
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,70,70,0.35)';
      g.beginPath(); g.arc(sx, sy, st.r, 0, TAU); g.fill();
    }
    g.restore();
  }

  /* arrow: same material language as the poly weapons (wood shaft, steel
   * broadhead, pale fletching, ink outline). The hitbox is the circle of
   * radius r centred on the head — the head tip spikes slightly PAST it
   * (safe direction: ink leads the hit), drawShot's halo inks the full disc,
   * and the shaft and feathers trail behind it. */



  /* v1.0 projectiles — doctrine (owner 2026-10-19: "nobody wants to see …
   * body taking damage when there is a visible gap"): the hitbox disc r is
   * ALWAYS inked. Disc-shaped shots drew inside r already; bolt heads spike
   * past r forward (safe direction) but leave the disc flanks bare, and the
   * spark/star/boom shapes notch — so every kind gets the orb's halo
   * treatment: a faint full-disc fill under the art, exactly radius r.
   * The bow's kindless arrow borrows the bolt's steel (same drawArrow art,
   * same bare-flank issue). 'shot' — the kill still's never-drawn fallback —
   * draws as a plain steel disc at the impact point.
   * Renderer-only; the sim never reads this. Alphas are dials. */
  const HALO = { orb: 'rgba(159,224,255,0.28)', spark: 'rgba(212,167,58,0.22)', star: 'rgba(143,163,181,0.24)', boom: 'rgba(143,163,181,0.18)', bolt: 'rgba(143,163,181,0.18)', arrow: 'rgba(143,163,181,0.18)', javelin: 'rgba(143,163,181,0.18)', knife: 'rgba(143,163,181,0.18)', spell: 'rgba(214,51,26,0.20)', halo: 'rgba(93,184,58,0.20)', nova: 'rgba(111,195,236,0.20)', vortex: 'rgba(236,95,26,0.20)' };   // every shot kind inks its own hitbox disc (owner directive 2026-10-19); spell-family tints follow their affinity locals; page/scroll retired with the kind splits (2026-10-25)   // javelin/page/scroll entries pre-wired 2026-10-22; scroll halo retinted at the 2026-10-23 reconcile to the held art KT parchment family (owner-reference colours) — every shot kind inks its own hitbox disc (owner directive 2026-10-19)
  /* ---- SHOT ART (2026-10-25, phase 2): the return-2 blocks, verbatim polys.
   * Affinity doctrine (owner 2026-10-25): spell-local reference colours —
   * KF fire (scroll comet), KP1/KP2 poison, KN1 frost (+KB), KV fire-orange

  const KF1 = '#d6331a', KF2 = '#ffb52e';   // scroll fire comet locals

  function shotMeta(art) {   // per-shape centroids + head presence, computed once per art object (per-frame before the 2026-10-25 cleanup)
    if (!art._c) {
      art._c = art.polys.map(pl => { let n = 0, ax = 0, ay = 0; for (const p of pl.subs[0]) { ax += p[0]; ay += p[1]; n++; } return [ax / n, ay / n]; });
      art._hh = art._c.some(c2 => c2[0] >= -4);
    }
    return art;

  /* SIGIL LEGIBILITY (owner pick 2026-10-28 — "grow + solid mark", applied to all four
   * spell-family kinds). WHY, measured: the nucleus was 10.5 world px across
   * = 5.68 css px at a ~541 css px arena, and because drawPolySet runs a full STROKE pass over
   * every poly before any FILL pass, the inner flame's fill painted over the nucleus's own 2px ink
   * — so the carrier mark sat BARE on the flame with no keyline at all, at 1.60–2.32:1 (all eight
   * carrier × kind pairs under the 3:1 bar; vortex + Speedy is a 1° hue gap). The shot also crosses
   * its own nucleus width in 15.4 ms ≈ 0.93 frames at 60Hz, which is why the fix is size and
   * contrast, never detail. WHAT: the nucleus becomes a plain disc whose radius IS the launched
   * hitbox (derived from WEAPONS[...].shot.r, so it tracks weaponScale instead of drifting), on a
   * dark ink plate 1.3× that disc (SIG_PLATE), flagged vis 1 so it paints without its own stroke; one
   * sigilPair(w, cx, cy) helper emits the pair for all four kinds. After:
   * carrier-on-ink 4.23:1 (Speedy) / 5.02:1 (Heavy), plate-on-flame 8.0–9.8:1, nucleus 8.44 css px.
   * DISCLOSED (a): these two polys per kind are IMPLEMENTER-GENERATED, not delivery-verbatim — the
   * flame layers stay exactly as delivered, and the retired nuclei (the scroll's 4-point star, the

   * (c) Measured while auditing this: the HALO hitbox tint disc is 100% HIDDEN under the opaque
   * flame art on all four kinds (pre-existing, not caused here) — which is exactly why the nucleus
   * carrying the true radius matters: it is the only visible cue of the shot's real size.
   * TRAP: vis 1 also makes a shape pulse-eligible, but only when its centroid x < −1; the nuclei sit
   * at x 0 (spell) and +1.25 (trio), so nothing pulses. Do not move a nucleus aft of −1 without
   * re-reading drawPolySet's pulse dial. Renderer-only: SHOTS_ART has no sim consumer (drawShot,
   * setShotArt, shotArtOf), so no fingerprint can move. */
  const SIG_N = 32;        // disc segments, nucleus and plate alike
  const SIG_PLATE = 1.3;   // plate radius as a multiple of the hitbox. NOT CFG.weaponScale (also 1.3) — unrelated dial.
                           // MEASURED CEILING: at 1.3× the plate still lies fully inside the BRIGHT INNER flame on all
                           // four kinds (0/720 boundary samples outside; clearance +0.35px scroll, +0.48px trio). Past
                           // that the plate edge meets the darker outer layer, where ink-on-flame falls from 8.0–9.8:1 to
                           // 2.93:1 (spell) / 4.19:1 (vortex) — re-measure before raising this, do not just dial it.
  const sigDisc = (cx, cy, r, n) => { const o = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = i / n * TAU; o.push([+(cx + r * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(2), +(cy + r * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(2)]); } return o; };
